about.description: Pre-IPO perpetual on trade[XYZ], the HIP-3 builder-deployed dex 'xyz' on Hyperliquid, tracking Anthropic, cash-settled in USDC. Listed 2026-10-26. 10x max leverage, isolated margin only (marginMode noCross), szDecimals 2. Per the venue's pre-IPO specification index it references 1 share of Anthropic, PBC Class A common stock (anticipated Nasdaq: ANT), quoted in USD, initial price $125, discovery bound +/-50%, anticipated listing 2026-11-20 with grace to 2027-01-19. SCALE NOTE: that is a PER-SHARE quote (~115), while Entropy io:anth and the other five Anthropic venues quote ~1878-1934 on a different basis (Entropy's is implied valuation in USD billions). Same underlying, different unit - the ratio held constant across trade[XYZ]'s first two days. Open interest and volume are USD notional and unaffected, and reference-asset rollups aggregate notional only, never price, so both sit under Reference Asset 'Anthropic' deliberately.
